fact: A GET_PRINCIPAL operation's output must have cardinality 0..1 (lower 0, upper 1); the model validation enforces this.
A GET_PRINCIPAL operation's output must have cardinality 0..1 (lower 0, upper 1); the model validation enforces this.
The java.util.Date parameter format is configured with the key ISO8601DateParamHandler.DATE_FORMAT (class simple name plus .DATE_FORMAT, no jaxrs.provider prefix).
Manual changes to generated files fail the build's checksum check; discard the changes or delete the file, or list it in .generator-ignore to keep it.
The CLI relocate command moves an element to a different parent (cross-parent move) and keeps its xmi:id; move only reorders within the same parent.
judo-cli validate exits non-zero on any validation failure; --strict is not needed for a failing exit code.
judo-cli transform runs on the live in-memory model, including unsaved mutations, not the on-disk ESM.
judo-cli transform runs esm2ui and the UI EVL checks on the in-memory model (skippable with --skip esm2ui).
A JCL operation script's generated Java method body is built from the first script block only; other blocks are ignored.
A delete statement in a JCL script generates a call to super.deleteElement(...) on the referenced object, not a direct DAO delete.
An Integer variable declared in a JCL script is generated as a java.math.BigInteger holder, not java.lang.Integer.
An Integer primitive query call in a JCL script is generated with BigInteger, not Integer (Integer is used only for enumeration queries).
Generated table name length limits: HSQLDB and PostgreSQL default to 62 characters for tables and 58 for columns; Oracle is 30 for both.
Generated column name length limits: HSQLDB and PostgreSQL default to 58 characters; Oracle is 30.
